SELECT distinct A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID || ':' || A.FINPROD_NAME text,
A.FINPROD_ID finprodId,
A.FINPROD_ABBR || ','|| A.FINPROD_NAME || ',' || A.FINPROD_ID || ',' || B.UNITVALUE_DEC || ',' || C.PUR_SPEED||','|| A.CCY ||','|| to_char(A.VDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') || ',' || to_char(A.MDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd')|| ',' || C.IS_CYCLE|| ',' || A.OPERATION_TYPE|| ',' || A.PROFIT_TYPE|| ',' || PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID || ',' ||
C.DEAL_MODE || ',' ||
A.CALENDAR_ID || ',' ||
C.TERM_TYPE || ',' || PSP.CONTINUE_FLAG || ',' ||
A.LIQUIDATION_YESNO object
FROM FIN_PRODUCT A
INNER JOIN PTL_MANAGE_OBJ PTL ON PTL.MANAGE_OBJ_ID = A.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY PTLAUTH ON PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTLAUTH.PORTFOLIO_ID INNER JOIN PRD_SALE_PARAM PSP ON A.FINPROD_ID = PSP.FINPROD_ID, PRD_VAL_PARAM B,FIN_PRODUCT_ADD C WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F16, jdbcType = VARCHAR}
AND A.PROFIT_TYPE in
#{item, jdbcType = VARCHAR}
AND C.ISSUE_STATUS IN (#{ISSUE_STATUS_01, jdbcType = VARCHAR}, #{ISSUE_STATUS_03, jdbcType = VARCHAR})
AND A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search}),'%')
AND A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{initValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND PTLAUTH.USER_ID = #{userName}
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT DEAL.FINPROD_ID FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL DEAL WHERE DEAL.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID AND DEAL.PS IN (#{PS_C20},#{PS_C5}) AND DEAL.IS_CANCEL = #{isCancel} AND nvl(DEAL.P_TRADE_ID,'null')='null' )

SELECT CDATE purNetValueDate,/*净值日*/ TDY_UNIT_VALUE purUnitNetValue,/*净值*/ TDY_SHARE_AMT purDealNum,/*剩余份额*/ TDY_UNPAID_INTINCEXP purDealAmt/*剩余可分配利息*/ FROM BOK_POSITION_PRD WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND CDATE < to_date(#{netValueDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') and not exists ( SELECT 1 FROM BOK_POSITION_PRD p WHERE p.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND p.CDATE < to_date(#{netValueDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND p.CDATE > BOK_POSITION_PRD.CDATE )
AND CDATE = (SELECT max(CDATE) FROM BOK_POSITION_PRD WHERE CDATE <= to_date(#{dealDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
AND ROWNUM = 1

and t.trade_date = to_date(#{netValueDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
and t.trade_date = to_date(#{dealDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
and t.PS IN('C1','C2')

total.totle_trade_id tradeId, pro.finprod_id finprodId, pro.finprod_market_id finprodMarketId, total.ps dealtype, pro.profit_type profitType, pro.operation_type operationType, padd.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, padd.is_cycle isCycle, padd.term_type termType, pro.ccy, pro.vdate, pro.mdate /*add by yejiejie 2019-2-26*/ ,ptpd.customers_Begin_Num customersBeginNum ,ptpd.customers_Add_Num customersAddNum ,ptpd.customers_Reduce_Num customersReduceNum, padd.DEAL_MODE dealMode from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL total inner join FIN_PRODUCT pro on total.finprod_id = pro.finprod_id inner join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD padd on padd.finprod_id=pro.finprod_id
